mapper.select:
select pid.id,pid.code,pid.name,pit.interface_type_code,pit.interface_type_name,pid.create_time,pid.update_time,pid.enable, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(pw.pay_name SEPARATOR ','), '') AS pay_name from pay_interface_define pid left join pay_interface_type pit on pid.pay_interface_type_id = pit.id left join pay_way pw on FIND_IN_SET(pw.id,pid.pay_way)
and pid.code = #{pageDTO.code}
and pid.name like concat('%', #{pageDTO.name},'%')
and pit.interface_type_name like concat('%', #{pageDTO.interfaceTypeName},'%')
GROUP BY pid.id ORDER BY pid.create_time DESC

select id,code, name, pay_interface_type_id, pay_way, `enable`,mch_channel_user_key, has_mch,has_isv_mch,remark,isv_params,isv_sub_mch_params,normal_mch_params from pay_interface_define where id = #{id}
